summary: Generates `site-astro/src/notebook-page.html` — the same single-file viewer `coldstart kb view` produces, with this repo's own real notebook baked in. Mirrors `scripts/graph-viewer/build-site-page.mjs` exactly, including substituting the real `<a id="home">` link into VIEW_TEMPLATE before calling renderViewHtml (renderViewHtml always clears the placeholder itself, so the substitution must happen on the template first — see the home-link-placeholder flow note). Requires `npm run build` first since it imports compiled `dist/kb/view.js` and `dist/kb/view-template.js` directly, not the TS source.
